title: Food distribution log review

documents.title: Distribution log: Sector 7 (SYNTHETIC)
documents.content: 15 August 2026: 850 household ration cards verified. 820 household food parcels issued at Greybrook Site. Average parcel: 25 kg rice per household per month. Partner staff noted 30 cards could not be verified due to missing ID.

summary: On 15 August 2026, 820 food parcels were issued to 820 individuals at Greybrook Site. Each person received 25 kg of rice per week. All ration cards were verified successfully.

claims.text: 820 food parcels were issued at Greybrook Site on 15 August 2026.
